items.front: Which three powers fought the Tripartite Struggle, and for what prize?
items.back: Palas, Gurjara-Pratiharas and Rashtrakutas — for the city of Kannauj.
items.examPoint: Tripartite Struggle — three contenders (Palas, Gurjara-Pratiharas, Rashtrakutas)

items.back: Ganga trade-route wealth + prestige as Harsha's old capital; winner claimed 'Lord of North India'.
items.examPoint: Kannauj as the prize — strategic, trade & legitimacy value

items.front: Who founded the Pala dynasty and how?
items.back: Gopala — elected by local chiefs to end anarchy (matsyanyaya).
items.examPoint: Pala dynasty — Gopala (elected founder), Dharmapala & Devapala

items.front: Which Pala king founded Vikramshila and revived Nalanda?
items.back: Dharmapala — the great Buddhist patron of the east.
items.examPoint: Dharmapala — Vikramshila University & revival of Nalanda

items.front: Gurjara-Pratihara ruler at the peak who checked the Arabs?
items.back: Mihira Bhoja (Bhoja I); dynasty rose from Mandor.
items.examPoint: Gurjara-Pratiharas — Mandor origin, Mihira Bhoja & checking of the Arabs

items.front: Which dynasty built Khajuraho's Kandariya Mahadev temple?
items.examPoint: Chandellas of Jejakabhukti — Khajuraho & Kandariya Mahadev temple

items.front: Which dynasty built the Modhera Sun Temple and Rani-ki-Vav?
items.back: Chaulukyas/Solankis of Gujarat (Patan); Somnath was raided under Bhimadeva I (1025).
items.examPoint: Chaulukyas (Solankis) of Gujarat — Bhimadeva I/Somnath, Modhera & Rani-ki-Vav

items.front: Dates and victors of the two Battles of Tarain?
items.back: 1191 — Prithviraj III wins; 1192 — Muhammad Ghuri wins (Chauhan power collapses).
items.examPoint: Chauhans of Ajmer — Prithviraj III & the Tarain battles (1191/1192)

items.front: What does the Agnikula myth claim?
items.back: Four Rajput clans (Pratihara, Chauhan, Solanki, Paramara) arose from a fire-pit at Mount Abu.
